title: Implement phased hybrid optimization loop with convergence detection and restart-on-stagnation
description:
Add --phased flag to cmd_optimize. When set, use phased hybrid loop: resolve -> structure -> polish.

Each phase splits mutable parameters by type:
- GA (island GA) for integer-based fields: ColumnLimit, IndentWidth, TabWidth, AccessModifierOffset. Crossover exploits ordinal proximity.
- nevergrad for categorical choices: BreakBeforeBraces, PointerAlignment, SortIncludes, AllowShortFunctionsOnASingleLine, etc. Direct categorical mutation.

Both optimizers run within each phase on their respective parameter subsets. Phase results merge into initial_config for the next phase.

Convergence: if a phase's best fitness equals the previous phase's best (no improvement), skip remaining phases.

Restart-on-stagnation: if a phase doesn't improve within the first 30% of its budget, re-run with a different optimizer. Max 1 restart per phase.

Budget split: total budget divided across phases, weighted by number of mutable params in each tier. Minimum 5 evaluations per phase.

Strangler fig: default behavior (single GA run) preserved. --phased enables new path. Both coexist.

Files:
- src/optimizer/phased.py (new) — _run_phase(), _run_phased_optimization(), _split_by_type()
- main.py — add --phased flag, --max-restarts (default 1), wire into cmd_optimize
- Wire measure_impact() between analysis and search space construction (only when --phased)

title: Add tmpfs temp directory support for faster optimization
description: When running the optimizer with multiple parallel jobs, each job creates a temporary copy of the repository in /tmp. This feature adds an optional --temp-dir argument with automatic detection of tmpfs filesystems when available.
